description: Camera and MLX90640 thermal fusion for CardputerZero

store.summary: Thermal aura over the camera view, with HUD, snapshots and recording
store.description:
AuraCam blends an MLX90640 32x24 thermal array into the IMX219 camera view as a registered, semi-transparent heat aura.

- Seven aura modes and nine thermal gradients (ironbow, whitehot, arctic, amber and more)
- Probe, high and low temperature markers and a pixel-font HUD, burned into snapshots and H.264 recordings
- Camera looks (natural, mono, high contrast, fast) and a wide field of view
- Calibration screen to align the thermal frame
- Optional M5Stack 8ANGLE unit on the side Grove port: eight knobs for threshold, opacity, range, blur, smoothing, exposure and contrast

Requires an MLX90640 breakout wired to the top EXT header (5VOUT, GND, I2C1 SDA/SCL). Setting I2C1 to 400 kHz raises the thermal rate from about 4 Hz to 16 Hz. Wiring, setup and the 8ANGLE bus are in the README.
